J_definition: J(G) = alpha*E_readout + beta*E_1q + gamma*E_2q + gamma_log*E_2q_log + eta_idle*E_idle + delta*N_SWAP + lambda_*D  (features min-max normalized to [0,1], 7-dim; E_2q_log=Σ -log(1-cz_error) SOTA 2606.12816, E_idle=depth*mean(1/T1+1/T2) SOTA 2405.18785)

synthetic_generation.method: FakeMarrakesh UniMind calibration-weighted SABRE, same 2026-08-29 snapshot (calib_full_e08.json), qiskit 2.5.1 transpilation opt_level=1

oob_analysis.interpretation: v3 scaler max D=121, E_idle=2.43 clipped k>8; v4 scaler expands to cover k<=18 so no clipping needed within expanded range; hold-out beyond k=18 would still extrapolate

method.fit: Dirichlet(1) simplex sampling n=8000 (7-dim) + corners/uniform, max Spearman
method.loo: leave-one-out, n_samples=5000 per fold, aggregated rho over held-out predictions
method.normalization: min-max per feature over 9 points before weighting (7 cols)
method.target_y: single: max_dev (QPU sweep); multi: est_2q_error (FakeMarrakesh+calib proxy) — ranking target
method.E_idle_source: single: 2*(1/T1+1/T2) per qubit; multi: depth*mean(1/T1+1/T2) from snapshot T1/T2 (calib_full_e08.json)
method.v4_note: Expanded dataset via FakeMarrakesh synthetic routing points k=2..18 (14 new UniMind), same calibration snapshot 2026-08-29, refit 7-dim J(G) with minmax over n>=20, zero quota
